## v1.11.2 — Interrupted swipes show the stored swipe again

### Fix
- After an interrupted swipe (stopped while generating a new swipe), SillyTavern returns to the previous swipe, but the message kept showing the aborted generation (no stages or cards) until the page was reloaded. The live generation is now bound to the swipe being generated as well as to the message, so the previous swipe shows its stored stages and cards again right away.

### Other
- **Built-in Petals 7.11.2.**

The artifact format is unchanged (3). The CLI has no changes besides the version.
